item.title: Peoria coach released on house arrest after latest sexual abuse allegation
item.description: Daniel C. Ruffin, a former Peoria High School basketball coach, was ordered to be released from custody after new allegations of sexual activity with a 17-year-old girl came to light, but was placed on house arrest and must stay away from the victim and other minors without supervision.

item.title: Peoria shooting: 63 rounds fired, one injured critically
item.description: A man was shot and is in critical condition after a gathering in Peoria's East Bluff, where 63 rounds were fired in 30 seconds, and the suspects fled before police arrived.

item.title: Farm Share Breakfast cancelled until further notice
item.description: The Peoria County Farm Bureau has canceled its annual Farmer Share of the Food Dollar Breakfast due to the sale of the Expo Gardens and the inability to find an alternate venue.

item.title: Bob's Discount Furniture opens in East Peoria
item.description: Bob's Discount Furniture has opened in East Peoria, offering discounted furniture and a cafe with complimentary treats, and has donated $5,000 to local schools and charities.

item.title: Peoria flower shops prepare for Valentine's Day frenzy
item.description: Florists in Peoria are working around the clock to prepare for Valentine's Day, with flower shop owners like Lindsey Rajkowski advising customers to place orders in advance to ensure the best arrangements.

item.title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks roar back into Peoria this weekend
item.description: The Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live tour returns to the Peoria Civic Center this weekend, featuring racing and freestyle competitions with trucks capable of launching 25 to 30 feet into the air, and a glow in the dark element.

item.title: Students at Dunlap and Richwoods protest ICE crackdown
item.description: Hundreds of high school students from Dunlap and Richwoods High Schools in Peoria, Illinois walked out of classes to protest the Trump Administration's crackdown on immigrants.

item.title: Twin Cities home show returns after 5-year absence
item.description: Habitat for Humanity hosted a Home Show in Bloomington to connect the community with vendors, with proceeds from booth sales and sponsorships going towards affordable housing in the Twin Cities.

item.title: Central Illinois airport starts non-stop flights to Phoenix
item.description: The Central Illinois Regional Airport will offer two non-stop flights a week from Bloomington, IL to Phoenix, AZ starting Friday night, with a celebration at the gate before takeoff.

item.title: Two Central Illinois couples share secrets after a combined 112 years of marriage
item.description: Two Central Illinois couples, married for 52 and 61 years respectively, share their stories of how love has lasted beyond one holiday, emphasizing the importance of commitment, communication, compromise, and small gestures.
